authorization: User approved execution of N0-N2 on 2026-10-11.
scope: Read-only snapshot of the current Paper1 manuscript, prior evidence, and native inputs before any new implementation or pilot.

git.note: The manuscript, data, and experiment sources are present as workspace files but untracked. A separate worktree at the current commit would omit them; work therefore stays in the authorized shared checkout and only new native_risk paths may be written through N2.

model_contract.nodes: Independent categorical predictions with supplied row-stochastic P[u,c].
model_contract.hyperedge_retention: a_e=1 iff all predicted labels on edge e agree.
model_contract.native_profiles: Binary majority-versus-rest at epsilon 0.05 and 0.15; original-label multiclass profile is a planned external-profile check, not executed in N0.
model_contract.native_graph_policy: Use the full original hyperedge slot list; do not delete, rewire, deduplicate, or relabel H0 edges.
model_contract.known_probability_boundary: P is specified by the controlled error profile; it is not claimed to be a calibrated real-classifier error model.

selection_rule: h=max hyperedge degree with smallest-id tie break; partner maximizes sum(1/|e|) over shared h-edges, excluding h, with smallest-id tie break. Evaluate singleton and pair on both datasets.

checks.manuscript_verifier: PASS: 12 protected theorem/proof blocks, mixed certificate, references, typesetting log, four frozen hashes, and six result tables.

write_policy: No changes to main.tex, main.pdf, prior upgrade protocol/results, or source datasets during N0-N2. New artifacts are confined to notes/native-risk and experiments/prob2-relation-error/native_risk.
